title: What the NFL Taught Nate Burleson About Money | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: What does it take to build a life and career after professional sports? Today, Jill and Mark are breaking format to sit down with "CBS Mornings" co-host and former NFL player Nate Burleson. Nate talks about his journey from the football field to television, and the financial decisions that shaped his second act. Don't miss this special episode, gang!
